description: 这是一个我的世界 fabric 的 mod ，他在游戏中集成了lua编程语言，同时支持了数据包资源包编辑等附属的小功能。

mods.name: MC Lua IDE
mods.description: Server-authoritative Lua scripting with an optional administrator IDE client.

releases.notes:
### Added
- `MC.Event.onBlockAttacked`, `MC.Event.onEntityAttacked` and `MC.Event.onBlockBroken` now carry the held item as `itemId`, `itemCount` and `itemComponents`, the same fields as `onItemUsed`, so a script can read `event.itemComponents["minecraft:custom_data"]["new_type"]` without calling `MC.Item.held`.

### Fixed
- Code editor find bar (Ctrl+F): the replace row (Replace / Replace all) is shown by default, and the buttons on the right are no longer pushed out of the bar.

### Tested
- The held-item fields were read back from a real `blockAttacked` event table in a game world, and the find bar was checked in a screenshot of the editor.

mods.name: MC Lua IDE
mods.description: Server-authoritative Lua scripting with an optional administrator IDE client.

releases.notes:
### Changed
- `componentsJson`, `entityDataJson`, `blockEntityDataJson` and `itemComponentsJson` (returned by `MC.Item.held`, `MC.Item.getSlot`, `MC.Item.equipment`, `MC.Entity.equipment`, `MC.Entity.components`, `MC.Block.get`, `MC.Item.validate` and the other item-stack functions) are now Lua tables, the same table as `components`, `entityData`, `blockEntityData` and `itemComponents`, instead of JSON text. Scripts that searched these fields as strings (for example `:find(...)`) need to read the table instead; passing them back as `components` still works.
- Shorter API descriptions for 57 functions in Chinese, with the matching English and Japanese texts. The scope wording that the checks require (for example LivingEntity) is kept.

mods.name: MC Lua IDE
mods.description: Server-authoritative Lua scripting with an optional administrator IDE client.

releases.notes:
### Added
- `MC.Player.movingForward(uuid)`: true while the player holds the forward key (W), as the client last reported it.
- `MC.Item.setSlotComponents(uuid, slot, components)` and `MC.Entity.setEquipmentComponents(uuid, equipmentSlot, components)`: change only the data components of the item already in a player inventory slot or an entity equipment slot (item and count stay; `["!minecraft:xxx"] = {}` removes a component). Reading components already existed (`MC.Item.getSlot`, `MC.Item.equipment`, `MC.Entity.equipment`).
- Ctrl+Enter in an insertable window (Ctrl+I insert, text JSON, Minecraft UI, API documentation, color picker, data component editor, datapack JSON editor) inserts the current content and closes the window.

### Changed
- API documentation code boxes use the editor font and scroll sideways, so Chinese and Japanese text no longer garbles and long lines are no longer cut off.
- Every installed CJK font now fills the glyphs the first one lacks, so Japanese kana and kanji render even when the first font is Chinese-only (this change was already in the working tree, not made by me).
- Shorter descriptions for `MC.Player.carried`, `MC.Player.relativePosition` and `MC.Item.clearCooldown` in Chinese, English and Japanese.

### Fixed
- Insert window: Up/Down no longer shows two highlighted rows, and Enter no longer also opens a drop-down list.

### Tested
- `MC.Player.movingForward`, `MC.Item.setSlotComponents` and `MC.Entity.setEquipmentComponents` were run in a real game world. The window key handling and the new code box were built and run without errors but not checked by eye.

mods.name: MC Lua IDE
mods.description: Server-authoritative Lua scripting with an optional administrator IDE client.

releases.notes:
### Added
- `MC.Block.fill(..., dimension?, keepExisting?, dropItems?)`: `keepExisting` fills only air and leaves existing blocks alone; `dropItems` destroys replaced blocks so they drop their loot instead of vanishing. Both default to false, so existing scripts behave as before.

### Changed
- `MC.apiVersion()` now returns the MC Lua IDE mod version (for example `"1.0.12"`) instead of the fixed string `"1"`. Scripts that compared it with `"1"` need updating.

### Tested
- `MC.Block.fill` with `keepExisting` and `dropItems` was run in a real game world: existing blocks kept, replaced blocks dropped items, plain fill dropped nothing.

mods.name: MC Lua IDE

releases.notes:
### Fixed
- API documentation: long lines in code boxes were cut off at the right edge; they now wrap onto the next row, indented like the original line, and tabs are shown as spaces. Insert and Copy still use the original code.

mods.name: MC Lua IDE
mods.description: Server-authoritative Lua scripting with an optional administrator IDE client.

releases.notes:
### Added
- `MC.Team.aggressive(entityUuid, enabled?)`: makes a mob actively attack players who are not on its team and living entities on other teams (a mob without a team attacks players only; creative and spectator players are left alone). Without `enabled` it only reports the current state. The setting is kept in memory and cleared when the server stops.
- Data component tree: Home / End jump to the first / last row and F2 edits the selected value.

### Fixed
- Data component tree: two highlight indicators could show at once (the selected row and the keyboard cursor on another row); the cursor now follows the selection.

### Tested
- `MC.Team.aggressive` was run in a real game world: a red zombie targets a blue zombie, ignores a teammate, and stops when switched off; players are rejected.

releases.notes:
### Fixed
- The code checker rejected a table for `MC.Entity.addData` / `MC.Block.addData` ("expected string") and for the `keys` of `hideData`; tables, lists and SNBT strings are now accepted.

### Tested
- `addData` / `hideData` were run in a real game world: entity and block `minecraft:custom_name` add and hide, SNBT strings, mixed component + NBT tables, protected fields, players, and blocks without a block entity.

mods.name: MC Lua IDE
mods.description: Server-authoritative Lua scripting with an optional administrator IDE client.

releases.notes:
### Changed
- `MC.Entity.addData` / `hideData` and `MC.Block.addData` / `hideData` take data components: table keys with a namespace such as `["minecraft:custom_name"]` are components, other keys stay NBT fields. The API documentation examples use this table form.

mods.name: MC Lua IDE
mods.description: Server-authoritative Lua scripting with an optional administrator IDE client.

releases.notes:
### Added
- `MC.Entity.addData` / `MC.Entity.hideData` and `MC.Block.addData` / `MC.Block.hideData`: add (SNBT string or Lua table) or hide top-level data fields on a live entity or a placed block's block entity.

### Changed
- Data component editor: the tree is keyboard driven (arrow keys move and fold, Enter opens the editing panel with the cursor in its input). The editing panel is no longer modal, so the code area stays editable.

### Fixed
- The log window and other live windows kept updating while the game had control, instead of freezing and not scrolling.
